text:
Emily - CSM: Heads-up — seeing a sudden usage spike for acme-corp, hitting ~95% of their per-minute token quota over the last 24h. Thinking a temporary quota bump + proactive comms. @Lina any customer-side context? :eyes:

Raj - CS Ops: Can you paste the 24h numbers (tokens, 429s, avg latency, spend) so I can validate and do the patch?

Emily - CSM: Pasting quick snapshot:
```
24h window: tokens=3,120,000 (peak per-min 190k)
rate limit configured: 200000/min
429s: 0.8% (spike to 3.2% around 03:10 UTC)
avg latency: 210ms
estimated daily spend: $1,720 -> projected +18% if sustained
```

Marco - Support: Confirming the 03:10 UTC blip — several requests from their campaign hit the dedicated pool and saw backpressure, matching S-4582. I left a note in the ticket with request IDs.

Lina - AE: Acme is running a short regional marketing blast, they told me it's time-limited (48–72h). Customer already asked for higher throughput earlier today and verbally OK'd a temporary bump. They want a heads-up email before we change anything.

Raj - CS Ops: Sounds good. I can raise token_rate_limit -> 300000/min for 72h and enable more aggressive autoscaling for that pool. I'll schedule the change at 09:00 UTC so we have logs before/after. Anyone object?

Emily - CSM: No objections. Please include a note about expected spend bump (~+18%) in the comms and set monitoring to 15-min alerts for 429% and error-rate >2%.

Raj - CS Ops: Will do. Applying change now to a canary customer config first, then to acme-corp at 09:00 UTC. I'll create a short rollback playbook.

quota-bot: Quota change queued: acme-corp token_rate_limit from 200000 -> 300000 (request qchg_2024_098). Scheduled: 2024-11-08T09:00:00Z.

Marco - Support: I'll create a rollback runbook: if error_rate > 5% or 429s > 6% for 15m, rollback to previous limit and notify oncall. Adding steps + playbook link to S-4582.

Lina - AE: I'll draft the proactive email now, include the spend note and the rollback clause. Will DM draft to @Emily by 08:40 UTC for signoff.

Raj - CS Ops: Change applied to canary, metrics look stable. No latency increase so far. I'll post hourly updates to this thread once the main change is live. :white_check_mark:

Emily - CSM: Thanks team — plan: 09:00 change, 09:30 proactive email to customer, monitoring for 72h, rollback criteria in place. Lina please confirm when you send the email. :mailbox_with_mail:

Lina - AE: Draft sent in DM, Emily approved with one small wording tweak. Email scheduled for 09:30 UTC. :thumbsup:

Raj - CS Ops: Main change applied at 09:00 UTC. quota-bot: Quota update complete: acme-corp token_rate_limit = 300000/min. ChangeID qchg_2024_098.

Marco - Support: Monitoring dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/acme-corp/usage. I'll escalate to eng-oncall if we cross thresholds.

Emily - CSM: Closing loop — customer notified, bump live, monitoring in place. Will log this in account health notes and track spend impact at EOD. Thanks everyone.
